m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Fine. Fine. Take the stupid Flapjack Pan! I don't know why she needs it though. Pingouins are supposed to eat crêpes! Is nothing sacred anymore? Gah!
Oh goodness! That's it, isn't it? My Flapjack Pan! I love my Flapjack Pan so much. Yes, I sure do.
Oh Lilly! It's time for us to depart. We've lost the wagon now, so you'll just have to carry the luggage...
You'll have to excuse me, Mistress, but I won't be going back with you. I'm going to stay here in Walruskberg. Yes, I surely am.
Don't be silly. I need you to carry the luggage...
I wish you the best of luck with that, Mistress. I certainly do. I hope you have a safe journey, very safe.
All right, Wizard. I guess this is goodbye. Or maybe I'll see you in the city. I'd like that, like it very much.
I'm sorry if I've given your friend Ivan cause to worry. Maybe Mariya has better news. You should speak with her.
The road is certainly safer, Ivan, but the bridge is another matter altogether. Believe me, I wish it was not the case.
You don't understand, Mariya. Ivan and Wizard must get through! Ivan must visit Urville Station and Wizard must find Baba Yaga.
There is one thing, I suppose. I make good flapjacks! Yes, I sure do. Could I sell flapjacks in Walruskberg? Maybe... if I had my Pan.
After we crossed the New Blago Bridge, the Tundra Trolls in the road demanded a toll, so the Duchess gave them my Flapjack Pan. She sure did.
I guess I'm out of luck. I surely am. Unless... you mean you would go get back my Flapjack Pan? Oh wow, that would be great, so very great.
I don't know. Can you imagine me, living free and getting to make flapjacks all day? Could that really happen?
It could. It could happen, couldn't it? If you'll get my Flapjack Pan back from the Tundra Trolls, I can do it. Yes. I know I can.
